The robot followed the corridor to the green panel and is now resting in front of it. The sonar read about 0.57 m from the panel when it stopped, and the panel filled the camera view.

The corridor ran straight, then turned left. The green panel was at the end of the left-hand stretch. I called `rest` once the robot was in position, and the state shows it crouched with the motors off. There were no falls.
